content:
Forwarding an announcement that is probably of interest to many people here:

This is to announce an online two-day workshop later this month.

DANGER 2: Data, Numbers, and Geometry
An online workshop focussing on applications of Machine Learning to Number Theory and Geometry.
25-26 August 2022

https://sites.google.com/view/danger2workshop

The speakers are:

  • Maria Cameron (University of Maryland)
  • Jesus De Loera (University of California, Davis)
  • Michael R. Douglas (Simons Center for Geometry and Physics)
  • Henry Kvinge (Pacific Northwest National Lab)
  • Anthea Monod (Imperial College London)
  • Alexey Pozdnyakov (University of Connecticut)
  • Margaret Regan (Duke University)
  • Geordie Williamson (University of Sydney)

Everybody is welcome.

On behalf of the organisers,

Alexander Kasprzyk
Thomas Oliver
Yang-Hui He
